1,1.label: Once-punctured torus (via the commutator subgroup Γ′)
1,1.wlName: word length in the generators of π₁(S)
1,1.note: Each point is one closed curve on the surface, written as a cyclic word in a free basis of π₁(S) (the side pairings of a fundamental polygon made of Farey triangles; letters A, B, C, … and their inverses a, b, c, …), counted once up to orientation. Only curves whose canonical lift complement is hyperbolic are shown; these are exactly the curves that fill the surface. The hover also gives the modular code word of the curve.
